column2: # filter and clean the vehicle dataset for modeling
# convert system values to numeric encoding:
filter(MODEL_YR >= 2011 & MODEL_YR <= 2023) %>%   # keep only recent model years
mutate_at(all_systems, ~ ifelse(. == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.), replace = TRUE), .)) %>%
distinct(MAKE, MODEL, MODEL_YR, .keep_all = TRUE) # remove duplicates by vehicle identity
